title: Quantitative Parisi formulas and fluctuations in the Sherrington-Kirkpatrick model
summary: We establish quantitative Parisi formulas and fluctuation bounds for the Sherrington-Kirkpatrick model at zero external field. In particular, using that the Parisi measure is supported on an interval, we show that for every fixed inverse temperature greater than one, the variance of the logarithmic partition function lies between orders $N^{4/15}$ and $N^{7/15}$. The same exponents hold for the ground-state variance. We also obtain upper and lower bounds on the finite-size bias of the mean free energy and ground-state energy, together with two-sided upper-tail estimates with exponent $6/5$…
